integrity: Analytic arguments are provided; independent mathematical review has not been performed. The finite computations are checks, not substitutes for the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: One-excitation non-Hermitian no-jump spectral statement on an odd open chain, single real off-center impurity and strictly positive fixed loss rate. The linewidth expansion is pointwise as detuning tends to zero and is not a full many-body Liouvillian relaxation claim; mathematical proof and finite sanity checks supplied.
title: Arithmetic protection and quadratic leakage of dark modes in a centrally lossy quantum chain
